facts.text: Jon and Gina are looking forward to making memories at the grand opening of Jon's dance studio.

evidence.quote: Yeah! Let's make some awesome memories tomorrow at the grand opening!
Can't wait to make more memories at your dance studio!

facts.text: Jon expresses gratitude for Gina's support and mentions wanting to savor the good vibes of the upcoming event.

evidence.quote: Tomorrow's gonna be an awesome night and I'm not gonna forget a second of it. I put so much into this and I want to savor all the good vibes.
Enjoy the good feels tomorrow, you earned it!

facts.text: Gina expresses excitement about being by Jon's side and making memories at the dance studio.

evidence.quote: I'll be right by your side, Jon. Let's live it up and make some great memories tomorrow. So excited!
Can't wait to make more memories at your dance studio!
